facts.text: The Pitt Pell Plus Program doubles any Federal Pell Grant awarded up to $7,395 for eligible undergraduate students across all five campuses.

sources.title: What is the Pitt Pell Plus Program? - Financial Aid | University of Pittsburgh

facts.text: Pitt's Pell Match program invests in students with the greatest financial need across all five Pitt campuses by matching federal Pell Grant funds.

sources.title: Access and Affordability | Office of the Provost - University of Pittsburgh
